blocks.h2: Why Lincoln Park Basements Back Up

tiles.h3: Storms That Fill the City Sewer
tiles.body: Chicago's combined sewers push water back toward basements.
Flow stops and debris piles up.

blocks.intro: Most of Chicago's sewers were built before 1930, and they carry rainwater and sewage in the same pipes.

items.body: The lowest living space in the building is the most exposed.
If it only happens in heavy rain, the city sewer is likely full. If it happens on dry days, your line is blocked.
A backflow valve or an [overhead sewer system](/chicago-lincoln-park/overhead-sewer-systems) keeps sewer water out.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Clear it, explain it, prevent it.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Chicago's combined sewers carry rain and wastewater together. In July 2023, the McCook Reservoir, one of the biggest pieces of the region's flood storage, filled to capacity. When that happens, water has nowhere to go but back up, and the lowest drains in the city feel it first. That's why a garden unit can flood even when every pipe in the building is clean. Protection devices are what make the difference.

blocks.h2: Sewer Backup Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Why does my basement back up only when it rains hard?
items.preview: The city's combined sewer fills up.
items.answer: Chicago's sewers carry rain and wastewater together. In a heavy storm, they fill and push water back into the lowest drains. A backflow valve or overhead sewer stops it.

items.q: Who pays for a backup in a condo building?
items.preview: It depends on your declaration and the cause.
items.answer: It depends on the condo declaration and where the problem was. We document the cause on video so the association and owners can sort it out.

items.q: Will insurance cover a sewer backup?
items.answer: Many policies need a sewer backup rider. Check with your agent.

items.q: How do I prevent another backup?
items.preview: Keep the line clear and add protection.
items.answer: Regular [sewer maintenance](/chicago-lincoln-park/sewer-maintenance), plus a backflow valve or overhead sewer if storms are the trigger.

items.q: Is a backup during a big storm anyone's fault?
items.answer: Usually not. The city system is full. Protection on your side is what helps.

items.q: How much does sewer backup service cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what caused it and how we reach the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
